# Sensible, dependency-light tmux defaults for coding sessions.

# Terminal capabilities
set -g default-terminal 'tmux-256color'
set -as terminal-features ',xterm-256color:RGB:clipboard'
set -as terminal-features ',wezterm:RGB:clipboard'
set -g extended-keys on
set -g focus-events on
set -s set-clipboard on

# Responsive interaction and generous command output history
set -sg escape-time 10
set -g history-limit 200000
set -g mouse on
set -g mode-keys vi
set -g status-keys vi

# Predictable numbering and session behavior
set -g base-index 1
setw -g pane-base-index 1
set -g renumber-windows on
set -g detach-on-destroy off
set -g set-titles on
set -g set-titles-string '#S:#I.#P #{pane_title}'

# Open new windows and panes in the current working directory
bind-key c new-window -c '#{pane_current_path}'
bind-key '"' split-window -v -c '#{pane_current_path}'
bind-key '%' split-window -h -c '#{pane_current_path}'

# Vim-style pane navigation and resizing
bind-key h select-pane -L
bind-key j select-pane -D
bind-key k select-pane -U
bind-key l select-pane -R
bind-key -r H resize-pane -L 5
bind-key -r J resize-pane -D 2
bind-key -r K resize-pane -U 2
bind-key -r L resize-pane -R 5

# Reload configuration without restarting the server
bind-key r source-file ~/.tmux.conf \; display-message 'tmux configuration reloaded'

# Vi copy mode with Wayland clipboard integration
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi v send-keys -X begin-selection
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi C-v send-keys -X rectangle-toggle
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi y send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel 'wl-copy'
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi Enter send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel 'wl-copy'
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi MouseDragEnd1Pane send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel 'wl-copy'
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi DoubleClick1Pane select-pane \; send-keys -X select-word \; send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel 'wl-copy'
bind-key -T copy-mode-vi TripleClick1Pane select-pane \; send-keys -X select-line \; send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel 'wl-copy'

# Fuzzy-switch to any window across all sessions (requires fzf)
bind-key C-f display-popup -E -w 80% -h 70% 'target=$(tmux list-windows -a -F "#{session_name}:#{window_index} #{window_name}" | fzf --reverse --prompt="window> " | cut -d" " -f1); [ -n "$target" ] && tmux switch-client -t "$target"'

# Compact status line with no platform-specific scripts or plugins
set -g status-interval 5
set -g status-left-length 40
set -g status-right-length 100
set -g status-style 'bg=#191919,fg=#dadada'
set -g status-left ' #[bold,fg=#ffaf00]#S #[default]'
set -g window-status-format ' #I:#W '
set -g window-status-current-format ' #[bold,bg=#ffaf00,fg=#191919]#I:#W#[default] '
set -g pane-border-style 'fg=#444444'
set -g pane-active-border-style 'fg=#ffaf00'
set -g status-right '#{?client_prefix,#[bold bg=#ffaf00 fg=#191919] PREFIX #[default] ,} #[fg=#888888]#{pane_current_path} #[fg=#dadada]| %Y-%m-%d %H:%M '
